limitations: Official realtime assistant pref_generation acknowledgment is omitted; it is model output, not dataset history
Official Bedrock Claude 3 Sonnet judge is declared only; replacement judge fidelity partial
Native JSON objects/lists and Python literal strings are both accepted; annotations remain private
Canonical topics come from explicit_preference; unmatched MCQ files are excluded and counted
MCQ uses mcq_options preference/question per upstream load_files_mcq; differences from explicit_preference are counted
MCQ order uses Go math/rand NewSource(41).Perm, sequential sorted topic/index order; differs from Python random.sample; each case records seed/order
